 Bennett Stirtz may be ready to show more following Thunder's crushing road trip 
 By Mark Nilon | Nov 20, 2026, 1:24 PM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Oct 25, 2026; Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, USA; Oklahoma City Thunder guard Bennett Stirtz (14) walks down the court during the first half at Paycom Center. Mandatory Credit: Alonzo Adams-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect There's no denying that Bennett Stirtz has thoroughly impressed so far in his first season with the OKC Thunder.
--> There's no denying that Bennett Stirtz has thoroughly impressed so far in his first season with the OKC Thunder.
 The 16 overall pick from this past June's draft currently finds himself ranking within the top 15 among rookies in points per game (7.1) and first in three-point percentage (45.1) out of those who have shot 15 or more attempts this year.
--> The 16 overall pick from this past June's draft currently finds himself ranking within the top 15 among rookies in points per game (7.1) and first in three-point percentage (45.1) out of those who have shot 15 or more attempts this year.
 Excitingly enough, however, there may actually be more to be unleashed by Stirtz in the near future.
--> Excitingly enough, however, there may actually be more to be unleashed by Stirtz in the near future.
 At least, that seems to be what he suggested during Friday's practice media session , as he admitted to reporters that he's unintentionally been holding back on the offensive end as of late, particularly during Oklahoma City's recent road tilt where they went just 1-3.
--> At least, that seems to be what he suggested during Friday's practice media session , as he admitted to reporters that he's unintentionally been holding back on the offensive end as of late, particularly during Oklahoma City's recent road tilt where they went just 1-3.
 After being a ball-dominant, rock-in-hand kind of player throughout his four-year collegiate career, Stirtz is now adjusting to a more off-ball style of play.
--> After being a ball-dominant, rock-in-hand kind of player throughout his four-year collegiate career, Stirtz is now adjusting to a more off-ball style of play.
 While learning to function in such a role, Stirtz acknowledged that he's been a bit reluctant to launch it "when I have an open shot," saying he "didn't do that in some games on the road trip."
--> While learning to function in such a role, Stirtz acknowledged that he's been a bit reluctant to launch it "when I have an open shot," saying he "didn't do that in some games on the road trip."
 This certainly proved to be the case during their final game against the Sacramento Kings, where, in just over 17 minutes played, he shot just three times.
--> This certainly proved to be the case during their final game against the Sacramento Kings, where, in just over 17 minutes played, he shot just three times.
 With their widespread injury woes and recent 1-4 skid, the Thunder need all the help they can get. A less reserved Stirtz could prove to be a great weapon for this offensively starved OKC squad.
--> With their widespread injury woes and recent 1-4 skid, the Thunder need all the help they can get. A less reserved Stirtz could prove to be a great weapon for this offensively starved OKC squad.
 Thunder have mightily underwhelmed from long range this season
--> Thunder have mightily underwhelmed from long range this season
 On top of being a surprisingly mid offensive unit (rank 16 in offensive rating), the Thunder have also been one of the worst three-point shooting squads in the entire association through 15 games of action.
--> On top of being a surprisingly mid offensive unit (rank 16 in offensive rating), the Thunder have also been one of the worst three-point shooting squads in the entire association through 15 games of action.
 Right now, Oklahoma City is knocking down long-range attempts at a 34.2 percent clip, the 10-worst mark in the entire league .
--> Right now, Oklahoma City is knocking down long-range attempts at a 34.2 percent clip, the 10-worst mark in the entire league .
 What should be of little shock to fans, it's become more evident by the day just how much the Thunder are missing their second- and third-best scoring weapons, Jalen Williams and Chet Holmgren, who have been sidelined since October 25 as a result of brutal, long-term injuries.
--> What should be of little shock to fans, it's become more evident by the day just how much the Thunder are missing their second- and third-best scoring weapons, Jalen Williams and Chet Holmgren, who have been sidelined since October 25 as a result of brutal, long-term injuries.
 Their response to the club's widespread health woes, with the pivot to a double-big lineup, has also certainly not done them any favors in the floor-spacing department. 
--> Their response to the club's widespread health woes, with the pivot to a double-big lineup, has also certainly not done them any favors in the floor-spacing department. 
 Hopefully, more of a shot-happy diet from someone like Stirtz can help the Thunder regress to the mean when it comes to their three-point shooting.
--> Hopefully, more of a shot-happy diet from someone like Stirtz can help the Thunder regress to the mean when it comes to their three-point shooting.
